    colors = {v for row in grid for v in row}
    bg = max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    wall = next(v for v in colors if v != bg)

    seen = set()

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if grid[sr][sc] == wall or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue

            # Find one 4-connected area separated by the wall lines.
            comp = set()
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                comp.add((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1, c), (r+1, c), (r, c-1), (r, c+1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                            grid[nr][nc] != wall and (nr, nc) not in seen):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            clues = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in comp
                     if grid[r][c] != bg]
            if not clues:
                continue

            # Distance layers start at the edge of the area, including edges
            # next to a wall or the edge of the grid.
            depth = {}
            q = deque()
            for r, c in comp:
                if (r == 0 or r == h-1 or c == 0 or c == w-1 or
                    (r-1, c) not in comp or (r+1, c) not in comp or
                    (r, c-1) not in comp or (r, c+1) not in comp):
                    depth[(r, c)] = 0
                    q.append((r, c))

            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                for nr, nc in ((r-1, c), (r+1, c), (r, c-1), (r, c+1)):
                    if (nr, nc) in comp and (nr, nc) not in depth:
                        depth[(nr, nc)] = depth[(r, c)] + 1
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            # Marker colors, ordered from the outside layer inward, repeat
            # through the successive distance layers.
            clues.sort(key=lambda p: (depth[p[:2]], p[0], p[1]))
            pattern = [v for _, _, v in clues]
            for r, c in comp:
                out[r][c] = pattern[depth[(r, c)] % len(pattern)]

    return out

def transform(grid):
    from collections import Counter, deque

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    freq = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = freq.most_common(1)[0][0]
    wall = next(v for v, _ in freq.most_common() if v != bg)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seen = set()

    for sr in range(h):
        for sc in range(w):
            if grid[sr][sc] == wall or (sr, sc) in seen:
                continue

            comp = set()
            q = deque([(sr, sc)])
            seen.add((sr, sc))
            while q:
                r, c = q.popleft()
                comp.add((r, c))
                for nr, nc in ((r-1,c), (r+1,c), (r,c-1), (r,c+1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < h and 0 <= nc < w and
                            grid[nr][nc] != wall and (nr, nc) not in seen):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        q.append((nr, nc))

            markers = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r, c in comp
                       if grid[r][c] != bg]
            if not markers:
                continue

            r0 = min(r for r, c in comp)
            r1 = max(r for r, c in comp)
            c0 = min(c for r, c in comp)
            c1 = max(c for r, c in comp)

            corners = [(r0,c0), (r0,c1), (r1,c0), (r1,c1)]
            cr, cc = min(corners, key=lambda p: min(
                abs(p[0]-r) + abs(p[1]-c) for r,c,_ in markers))

            # Read diagonal marker chains outward from the nearest corner.
            remaining = {(r,c) for r,c,_ in markers}
            groups = []
            while remaining:
                seed = remaining.pop()
                group = {seed}
                stack = [seed]
                while stack:
                    r,c = stack.pop()
                    for dr in (-1,0,1):
                        for dc in (-1,0,1):
                            p = (r+dr,c+dc)
                            if (dr or dc) and p in remaining:
                                remaining.remove(p)
                                group.add(p)
                                stack.append(p)
                groups.append(group)

            group = min(groups, key=lambda g: min(
                abs(cr-r)+abs(cc-c) for r,c in g))
            pattern = [grid[r][c] for r,c in sorted(
                group, key=lambda p: abs(cr-p[0])+abs(cc-p[1]))]

            for r,c in comp:
                depth = min(r-r0, r1-r, c-c0, c1-c)
                out[r][c] = pattern[depth % len(pattern)]

    return out
